newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SWIMMING-VOELKER WINS WOMEN'S 50 FREESTYLE WORLD TITLE.
newsitem.headline: SWIMMING-VOELKER WINS WOMEN'S 50 FREESTYLE WORLD TITLE.

text.p: Sandra Voelker claimed Germany's first title on the second day of the world short-course championships with a hard-fought victory in the women's 50 metres freestyle final on Friday.
Voelker, who took the silver behind Jenny Thompson in Thursday's 100 freestyle, turned the tables on her rival to beat the American by 0.08 of a second in 24.70 seconds.
China's world record holder Le Jingyi, who had to settle for third in the 100, took the bronze again in 24.83.
Le, whose 24.23 world mark was not seriously challenged, had won both the 50 and 100 freestyle at each of the two previous world short-course championships.
Voelker, who gained silver and bronze medals in the freestyle sprints at the Atlanta Olympics, could not match her morning heat time of 24.62 which sliced 0.05 from her own European record.
